WITH DEP_FACT AS (
SELECT 
     GAM_ACID
    ,FORACID
    ,GAM_BANK_ID
    ,AS_OF_DATE
    ,CUST_ID
    ,SOL_ID
    ,ACCT_NAME
    ,GAM_SCHM_CODE
    ,GAM_SCHM_TYPE
    ,ACCT_CLS_FLG
    ,CIF_ID
    ,DEP_ACCOUNT_STATUS
FROM EDS.DEPOSIT_FACT EDF
JOIN EDS.EDS_CTL CTL 
    ON EDF.AS_OF_DATE = CTL.DEPOSITS_DATE
WHERE EDF.GAM_SCHM_TYPE = 'CAA' AND SUBSTRING(TRIM(EDF.GAM_SCHM_CODE), 1, 2) <> '09' AND EDF.GAM_BANK_ID = 'CBC01'
and CIF_ID IN ('R56601328'
,'R65700060'
,'R12700529'
,'R79602001'
,'R72701219'
,'R12301586'
,'R90000452'
,'R26401968'
,'R93601058'
,'R06400033'
,'R11501463')
)

, DEP_AAS AS (
SELECT 
CUST_ID
,ACID
,BANK_ID
,AS_OF_DATE
,Account_Relationship
FROM (
    SELECT 
         CUST_ID
        ,ACID
        ,EDA.BANK_ID
        ,AS_OF_DATE
        ,CASE WHEN EDA.ACCT_POA_AS_REC_TYPE = 'M' THEN 'Main Holder'
              WHEN EDA.ACCT_POA_AS_REC_TYPE = 'J' THEN 'Joint Holder'
              WHEN EDA.ACCT_POA_AS_REC_TYPE = 'A' THEN 'Authorized Signatory'
              WHEN EDA.ACCT_POA_AS_REC_TYPE = 'G' THEN 'Guarantor'
              WHEN EDA.ACCT_POA_AS_REC_TYPE = 'L' THEN 'Letter of Authority'
              ELSE 'Others' 
        END AS Account_Relationship
    FROM EDS.DEP_ACCOUNTRELATIONSHIP EDA
    JOIN EDS.EDS_CTL CTL
        ON EDA.AS_OF_DATE = CTL.DEPOSITS_DATE
    WHERE EDA.DEL_FLG <> 'Y' AND EDA.ENTITY_CRE_FLG = 'Y' AND EDA.BANK_ID = 'CBC01'
    AND CUST_ID IN ('A_TEST','B_TEST','C_TEST','D_TEST','E_TEST','F_TEST','G_TEST','H_TEST','I_TEST','J_TEST','K_TEST')
    )A
GROUP BY
CUST_ID
,ACID
,BANK_ID
,AS_OF_DATE
,Account_Relationship
HAVING COUNT(*) = 1

WITH  DEP_AAS AS (
SELECT 
EDA.CUST_ID
,EDA.ACID
,EDA.BANK_ID
,EDA.AS_OF_DATE
,CASE WHEN EDA.ACCT_POA_AS_REC_TYPE = 'M' THEN 'Main Holder'
      WHEN EDA.ACCT_POA_AS_REC_TYPE = 'J' THEN 'Joint Holder'
      WHEN EDA.ACCT_POA_AS_REC_TYPE = 'A' THEN 'Authorized Signatory'
      WHEN EDA.ACCT_POA_AS_REC_TYPE = 'G' THEN 'Guarantor'
      WHEN EDA.ACCT_POA_AS_REC_TYPE = 'L' THEN 'Letter of Authority'
      ELSE 'Others' 
      END AS Account_Relationship
FROM EDS.DEP_ACCOUNTRELATIONSHIP EDA 
INNER JOIN  (SELECT ACID,EDA.BANK_ID,AS_OF_DATE
             FROM EDS.DEP_ACCOUNTRELATIONSHIP EDA
             JOIN EDS.EDS_CTL CTL
                 ON EDA.AS_OF_DATE = CTL.DEPOSITS_DATE
             WHERE EDA.DEL_FLG <> 'Y' AND EDA.ENTITY_CRE_FLG = 'Y' AND EDA.BANK_ID = 'CBC01'
             GROUP BY ACID,EDA.BANK_ID,AS_OF_DATE
             HAVING COUNT(*) = 1
             )A ON EDA.ACID = A.ACID 
             AND EDA.BANK_ID = A.BANK_ID 
             AND EDA.AS_OF_DATE = A.AS_OF_DATE
WHERE EDA.DEL_FLG <> 'Y' AND EDA.ENTITY_CRE_FLG = 'Y' AND EDA.BANK_ID = 'CBC01'
)
SELECT 'SOURCE' TBLS, COUNT(1) CNT FROM DEP_AAS UNION ALL
SELECT 'SYN_VIEW' TBLS, COUNT(1) CNT from [syn].[CHECK_NAME_SINGLE_CUSTOMER]
